answer: The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in forge, expire in vine, and whisper lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 17 aliases therefore needs 123 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4429 identities would post 3890 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
